title: prionopsis ciliata
intro: Prionopsis ciliata, commonly known as the Philippine fern, is a type of flowering plant in the family Madder. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Prionopsis ciliata include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe wounds and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic properties.
